The structure of Er3Al3Ir3 (ErAlIr) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with nine atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Ir each adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom, while Er has 16 neighbors, forming a three-dimensional connected network. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Al and Ir 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Er 16-vertex polyhedra.
